name: Arima Onsen
text: Arima Onsen (有馬温泉, Arima Onsen) is an onsen, or hot spring resort in Kita-ku, Kobe, Japan, located near Mount Rokkō. This onsen attracts many Japanese because of its easy access from the busy cities in the Kansai metropolitan area including Osaka and Kobe. Arima Onsen was named in the Heian-period The Pillow Book as one of the three famous springs in Japan.

depictions.name: Arima Onsen
depictions.text: Arima Onsen (有馬温泉) is a hot spring located in southern Kakogawa Estuary in Harima, Japan.
